seatedToss.guidance: Mutuule ku mmeeza mukyusakyuse okusuula ekisawo ekipya mu kiwendo ekinene. Okubala kukuume ku mpapula, mwenna wamu.
steps: Sala ekiwendo n'empapula y'okubala, ozitekeko nga zigaziridde ku mmeeza wakati wammwe.
Mutuule bulungi, buli omu ku ludda lwe. Mukyusakyuse, buli omu asuula omulundo gumu omuyonjo, oba oyinza okuyitawo bw'oba toyagala.
Ekisawo bwe kigwa mu mpeta, oyo asudde asiiga akabonero mu kasanduuko ke, ku murongo gw'empeta eyo.
Bw'omala, mutunuulire obubonero wamu bw'oba oyagala. Tewali amu alina okuteekateeka nate namba.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Kozesa kisawo kinnya ekiriko ekikuubo ekisibiddwa, oba engatto ezikuŋŋaanyiziddwa. Tuula, tosuula okutunuulira mu maaso, era omuntu omukulu abe kumpi. Ebitundu ebitono biyinza okuziyiza omuntu okussa.
flags: Si ku bantu abali wansi w'emyaka 3: ebitundu ebitono
safety: Londa kisawo ekiriko ekikuubo ekisibiddwa, oba kunyiga engatto ennyonjo. Kebera nga tekirina bunnya oba nnyuzi ezitasibiddwa bulungi, ebintu munda bireme okuvaamu.
Ebinyeebwa, omuceere n'ebintu ebirala ebitono bisobola okuziyiza omuntu okussa. Bikuume wala n'abaana abato ne buli muntu ayingiza ebintu mu kamwa.
Beera mu bbanga ly'omukono era weekebeje nnyo singa waliwo ekiyinza okuteekebwa mu kamwa.
Tuula. Suula mpola era wansi okutuukira ekiwendo ku mmeeza, si mu maaso g'omuntu.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Empapula ey'okusaalibwa: ekiwendo ky'empeta ssatu ezirina amannya Ekiri okumpi, Ekiri wakati ne Ekiri wala, okuva ebweru okutuuka munda, n'empapula y'okubala ng'erina ekifo ky'buli muntu n'ennyiriri z'obusanduuko obutaliimu buli mpeta.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Teeka empapula wakati wammwe nga egaziridde. Ekisawo bwe kigwa mu mpeta, sala akabonero mu kasanduuko ko, ku murongo gw'empeta eyo.

Obubaka mubuwandiike wamu, oba omu awandiike ky'omulala ky'agamba.
Buli muntu asobola okuyimirira mu kiseera kyonna. Tewali kaadi ntuufu.

coloringWall.guidance: Londa ekifaananyi n'omuwendo gw'empapula. Siiga bbugwe, buli muntu asiige langi empapula emu oba nnyingi. Tewali kibalibwa, tewali kipimibwa mu biseera, era tewali kitereekebwa.
coloringWall.previewLabel: Ekifaananyi {picture|lower} kyagabanyizibwamu empapula {n}, {across} mu bugazi ne {down} mu buwanvu. Buli lupapula lulina akabonero mu nsonda yalwo.
coloringWall.previewCaption: Ekifaananyi nga kiriko enkonkoma z'empapula n'obubonero.
coloringWall.labelsNote: Ennukuta zigenda wansi ku bbugwe ate namba zigenda mu bugazi bwayo, kale A1 y'olupapula olw'omu kkono ku ntikko.
steps: Siiga empapula zonna. Olupapula olusooka lulimu emitendera gino n'ekifaananyi kya bbugwe.
Buli muntu addira olupapula lumu oba nnyingi n'alusiiga langi.
Langi n'engeri y'okukola tezeetaaga kwenkana. Buli lupapula lutuukiriza ekifaananyi kimu.
Teeka empapula mu nteekateeka y'obubonero bwazo, oluvannyuma zikwatire wamu n'akatimba ku mabega.
Teeka bbugwe awantu buli muntu w'asobola okulaba.

coloringWall.pictureLine: Ekifaananyi: {picture}. Bbugwe lino lirimu empapula {n}: {across} mu bugazi ne {down} mu buwanvu.

wordSearch.gridLabel: Olutimbe lw'ennukuta, ennyiriri {n} ez'ennukuta {n}. Kozesa obusale okutambula wakati w'ennukuta.
wordSearch.unavailable: Olukalala lw'ennukuta terunnyonnyoka bulungi mu lulimi luno, n'olwekyo okunoonya ebigambo tekuli wano. Gezako emizannyo gy'ebifaananyi mu kifo ky'ekyo.

coloring.guidance: Nyiga ku langi, oluvannyuma onyige ku kitundu ky'ekifaananyi.

conversationCards.guidance: Soma kaada eno mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka. Tewali kuddamu kutuufu kwokka.
conversationCards.groupSit: Mutuule mu bwetoolo awatali buzibu buli muntu w'alaba ekifaananyi. Omuntu akutte kaadi, oba ekyuma ekirina ekifaananyi ekinene, asooka okusoma ekisikiriza mu ddoboozi.
conversationCards.groupPass: Oluvannyuma yisa kaadi omuntu ageddako. Buli muntu ayogera ekigambo oba olunyiriri ku kifaananyi, oluvannyuma aliyisa.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Okuyisa kaadi kikkirizibwa buli kiseera. Omuntu asobola okuyisa awatali kwogera, era tewali n'omu yeetaaga kunnyonnyola lwaki.
conversationCards.groupEnd: Omuzannyo guggwa kaadi bw'eba etambudde wonna mu ttabamiruka, oba ekibinja bwe kiba kimaze. Tewali awangula. Kikomye essaawa yonna ekibinja kye kiyagaliza.

photoPairs.guidance: Nyiga ku kifaananyi, oluvannyuma onyige ku kifaanagana nakyo.
photoPairs.intro: **Londa ebifaananyi 2 okutuuka ku 6** okuva ku kyuma kino. Biragibwa ku lupapula luno lwokka era tebitikkibwa ku mutimbagano oba okuterekebwa.
photoPairs.atLeastTwo: Bambi londa ebifaananyi ebitakka wansi wa bibiri.

skipped.one: Fayiro {count} teyabadde kifaananyi kye tusobola okulaga.
skipped.other: Fayiro {count} tezaabadde bifaananyi bye tusobola okulaga.

photoPairs.empty: Ebifaananyi byammwe bijja kulabikira wano, buli kimu emirundi ebiri.

pictureBingo.guidance: Sooka ofulumye kaada zino. Oluvannyuma olage omulangizi ono ku sikuliini esinga obunene gy'olina.
pictureBingo.start: Nyiga ku "Ekifaananyi ekiddako" okuyita ekifaananyi ekisooka.

calmBreathing.guidance: Ssa omukka munda ekyetoolo bwe kiba kigaziwa, era osse ebweru bwe kiba kikendera. Kiyimirira kyokka oluvannyuma lw'okussa emirundi mukaaga.
calmBreathing.started: Kitandise. Ssa omukka munda ekyetoolo bwe kiba kigaziwa.
calmBreathing.finished: Gano gabadde masooba mukaaga ag'ompolampola. Tandika nate buli lw'oba oyagadde.

storyChain.guidance: Mukyuse: buli muntu ayogere omusango gumu, ng'ongerako ekifaananyi ekiddako.
storyChain.passNote: Yogera omusango gwo waggulu. Tewali kikubibwa wadde okutereka. Buli muntu asobola okuyitako.
storyChain.full: Olujegere lulimu ebifaananyi munaana. Yogera olugero lwonna, oba otandike olujegere oluggya.

pictures.painted-plant-pot: Ensuwa y'ebimera eyasiigibwako langi n'ebikoola by'akawoowo
pictures.open-songbook-with-notes: Ekitabo ky'ennyimba ekiggule, ekirimu obubonero bw'ennyimba
pictures.pine-cone-bird-feeder: Ekyokuliisa ennyonyi ekya payini ekiwanikiddwa ku ttabi
pictures.buttons-in-muffin-tin: Bbataani ezitegekeddwa mu kibya kya keeki
